name: Pamplona (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Pamplona (a white lion on green within a bordure of the chains of Navarre on red).
history: The flag and arms of Pamplona are its official symbols; the flag is green, of proportions 2 to 3, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre. The creation and definition of both go back to the Privilegio de la Unión, the founding charter of the city granted by King Charles III the Noble on 8 September 1423; although that document laid down the use of blue for the city's banner, blue and white were the colours used until the adoption of green, the reasons for which have not yet been documented.
